settings.heading: Six convergent mechanisms in one capsule

settings.text:
Complete is engineered around six distinct mechanisms with one absorption-helper:

1. Fibrin clearance — Nattokinase + Serrapeptase + Bromelain. Three proteolytic enzymes with overlapping but non-identical substrate specificities. Where one slips, another catches.

2. Spike-protein adjacency — Nattokinase (in vitro spike-protein degradation, Tanikawa 2022) + Dandelion Root (in vitro spike-ACE2 binding inhibition, Liu 2021).

3. Liver / detoxification phase II — Dandelion Root (bile flow) + NAC (glutathione precursor). The cleared substrates need an exit route; the liver provides it.

4. Antioxidant / mitochondrial buffer — NAC (glutathione precursor) + Quercetin (NF-κB and free-radical scavenging). When you break down clots and damaged proteins you generate oxidative byproducts; these two cover that bill.

5. Histamine / mast-cell modulation — Quercetin. The lever the autoimmune and post-viral communities specifically reach for.

6. Anti-inflammatory cytokine control — Bromelain + Quercetin + NAC. Three converging mechanisms on NF-κB / TNF-α / IL-6 pathways.

+ Bioavailability enhancer — BioPerine 5 mg/cap (20 mg/day at 4 caps), the same dose Shoba 1998 used to multiply curcumin absorption by 20×. Quercetin in particular has poor oral bioavailability without a co-formulation; BioPerine and bromelain fix that.

settings.label: Recent research on post-viral microvascular health
settings.title: Recent research on post-viral microvascular health.
settings.body: Two newer findings widen nattokinase's relevance. Tanikawa et al. (2022, Molecules) showed in vitro that purified nattokinase degrades the SARS-CoV-2 spike protein and ACE2 in 60–180 minutes — a cell-lysate / lab-bench study, not yet a human trial. Grixti, Pretorius & Kell (2024, preprint) showed that recombinant nattokinase degrades fibrinaloid microclots — the anomalous, fibrinolysis-resistant clots documented in Long COVID and ME/CFS — within 2 hours in vitro. Liu et al. (2021) showed dandelion-root extract blocks spike-protein binding to ACE2 in vitro — a separate angle on the same target. Both findings are mechanistic; none are human RCTs yet.

settings.heading: Tokyo, 1980. A lunch that changed cardiovascular research.
settings.paragraph_1: Dr. Hiroyuki Sumi was a Japanese researcher screening 173 natural foods for fibrin-dissolving activity. One afternoon he dropped a piece of natto — fermented soybeans, eaten in Japan since the 11th century — onto a Petri dish of artificial fibrin. Within 18 hours, the fibrin had dissolved.
settings.paragraph_2: Sumi named the enzyme he isolated nattokinase. The discovery launched a 40-year research arc that pulled in adjacent enzymes — bromelain (from pineapple), serrapeptase (from a silkworm-gut bacterium) — and antioxidant cofactors like NAC and quercetin. Every active in Complete is built on a clinical record measured in decades, not seasons.
settings.paragraph_3: We built Complete around the same wild-fermented Bacillus subtilis strain Sumi worked with — paired with six clinically-studied co-actives chosen for convergent mechanisms. No proprietary blend. No borrowed celebrity authority. Just the molecules, dosed honestly, with every milligram on the label.
settings.pullquote: The molecule he isolated is the cornerstone of every capsule we make 45 years later.

Honest answer: because Complete pairs nattokinase with six other clinically-studied actives in one capsule. The capsule shell only has so much room.

Pure (4,000 FU/cap) is for the buyer whose only lever is nattokinase and who wants to land at 12,000 FU/day. settings.title: Is it safe with Eliquis, Xarelto, warfarin, or aspirin?
settings.content:
Talk to your prescribing physician before starting. The whole stack has fibrinolytic activity — three proteolytic enzymes plus quercetin's mild anti-platelet effect — so the conversation matters more, not less, vs. a single-ingredient product. We removed vitamin K2 specifically because K2 interacts with vitamin-K-antagonists like warfarin.

Chen 2022 reported no adverse events across 1,062 adults at 10,800 FU/day for 12 months. Their aspirin co-administration arm (n=96, 100 mg/day) saw lipid synergy without bleeding events. None of the published trials are randomized DOAC-safety studies — which is precisely why this conversation belongs with your care team.

settings.title: I'm on Eliquis (or Xarelto / warfarin) for AFib. Can I take this?
settings.content:
Possibly — but as a complement, never a substitute, and only with your physician.

Honest framing: nattokinase has fibrinolytic activity, and Complete pairs it with bromelain, serrapeptase, and quercetin — all of which carry mild additive anti-clotting effects. Chen 2022's aspirin co-administration arm saw lipid synergy without recorded bleeding events, but that's not a randomized DOAC-safety study.

The case to know about: Elahi 2015 documented a thrombus in a patient who substituted low-dose nattokinase for warfarin without physician oversight. The lesson is in the substitution — not the pairing. AFib subs in our community routinely report taking a fibrinolytic stack complementary to their prescription anticoagulant under their cardiologist's supervision.

Bring the formula bible to your next appointment. We removed K2 specifically to make that conversation easier.

settings.title: Why did you remove K2? Can I get it from you?
settings.content:
K2 (menaquinone-7, MK-7) can interact with vitamin-K-antagonist blood thinners like warfarin. Many spike-protocol products bundle K2 in by default, which makes them incompatible with that population. We removed it to maximize compatibility — and we're honest: Chen 2022 actually shows K2 was synergistic with nattokinase for lipid endpoints (TC –17.6% with K2 vs –16.3% without).

If you don't take vitamin-K-antagonists and want the K2 + NK synergy Chen 2022 describes, we sell K2 MK-7 separately — $14 standalone, $9 when bundled with Complete or Pure.

settings.title: How long until I notice a difference?
settings.content: Honest answer: it varies, and no one can promise an outcome. Chen 2022 measured cardiovascular endpoints at 12 months. The microclot in vitro work (Grixti/Kell 2024 preprint) acts within hours in a test tube but in-vivo translation isn't established. We don't make week-by-week promises about how you'll feel.

4 capsules per day, split into two doses: 2 caps before breakfast (empty stomach, full glass of water), 2 caps mid-afternoon (≥2 hours after lunch, ≥30 minutes before the next meal). Empty-stomach administration matters for the proteolytic enzymes (nattokinase, bromelain, serrapeptase) — food reduces systemic enzyme activity.

Lower-intensity onboarding for cautious or smaller-frame users: 2 caps/day for the first 2 weeks, then titrate to 4. Separate from PRN nitroglycerin by ≥2 hr (NAC interaction). Separate from levothyroxine by ≥4 hr (standard caution).
